rubric.name: 6+1 Trait Writing
rubric.source: Education Northwest, 6+1 Trait Writing model (traits used for grouping and reporting only).

note: Draft Grade 8 writing profile for essay analysis. Expected bands are draft values (band 5 ~ CEFR B1, indicative). Every curriculum mapping is unvalidated until an educator reviews it. Competencies marked specified=false exist in the framework but have no descriptors, questions or lessons yet: they can be observed in an essay but not diagnosed or taught. Every expected band is provisional (uncalibrated): see docs/product/essay-learning/BAND_AUDIT.md. Version 2 (18 October 2026) adds Plurals and countability (EN.GRM.NOUN.plurals_countability, an existing specified framework leaf) so essays can show singular/plural noun errors; its band-5 target is provisional like every other.
